wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_ac.name: Foundry acceptance demo
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_ac.description: Runs a full demonstration of the agent factory end to end, clearly labelled so test stand-ins are never mistaken for real model results.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_ag.name: Model providers
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_ag.description: Connects agents to a real AI model through the Codex command line, or to a clearly labelled test stand-in, with a time limit on every call.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_de.name: Agent design choices
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_de.description: Picks which known kind of task an agent is for and the smallest design that can do it.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_ex.name: Agent test runner
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_ex.description: Writes an agent bundle to disk and runs it in a limited local process through normal, edge, hostile and recovery scenarios.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_fa.name: Task type contracts
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_fa.description: Holds the written contracts for each supported kind of agent task; picking one also picks the design.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_in.name: Goal intake
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_in.description: Pulls only stated facts from the owner's goal and asks the single most useful next question instead of guessing.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_li.name: Agent repair
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_li.description: Prepares and checks a fix to an agent first, and only then publishes the new version.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_mo.name: Foundry data definitions
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_mo.description: Defines the fixed shapes of agent projects, stages, evidence, permissions and decisions used across the factory.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_ru.name: Agent builder
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_ru.description: Turns an approved agent design into a runnable Python bundle, refusing capabilities it cannot support and blocking network use.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_sa.name: Agent sandbox
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_sa.description: Wraps generated agent code in an operating-system lock: no home folder, no file writes, no network, no launching other programs.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_sc.name: Agent test cases
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_sc.description: Holds the shared test cases and pass checks used to evaluate an agent and to catch regressions.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_sc.name: Reusable parts scout
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_sc.description: Searches for existing agent components to reuse and rates each with its evidence, using GitHub search or a local test source.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_st.name: Safe saving
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_st.description: Saves agent project records and builds so a crash can never leave a half-written version, and old versions stay intact.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_va.name: Agent spec checker
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry_va.description: Checks an agent specification for defects and returns a clear list of what to fix.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry.py.name: Agent Foundry
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/foundry.py.description: Drives an agent project from a vague goal through questions, checks, building, testing, repair and packaging, and can resume where it stopped.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/templates/.name: Generated agent template
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/templates/.description: The standalone agent program placed in each bundle; it asks the trusted host to make model calls and never calls a model itself.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/templates/.name: Model call go-between
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/templates/.description: Passes model requests between a generated agent and the real model, cutting off silent or broken agents at a deadline.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/templates/.name: Model reply reader
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/templates/.description: Reads and classifies the model command's output, keeping error notes without storing raw messages.
